# `aitbc market job-probe`

POST a job-create body with a caller-controlled payload.escrow_job_id. Replays the #2326 alias-binding refusal legs through the CLI: an unsigned alias claim and a signature bound to a different escrow key must both be refused (403), while a self-bound job (no ``--escrow-job-id``) creates normally. The API key comes from the group's ``--api-key`` or the usual MARKET_API_KEY/config resolution.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market job-probe [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service-type` | text | `whisper` | no | Job service_type (default: whisper). |
| `--escrow-job-id` | text | — | no | payload.escrow_job_id — an alias claim, which requires a buyer signature unless --no-signature |
| `--sign-escrow-job-id` | text | — | no | Sign the alias binding for this escrow id instead of --escrow-job-id (mismatch replay) |
| `--no-signature` | flag | `false` | no | Send the alias claim without signature fields (the server refuses with 403) |
| `--buyer-address` | text | — | no | Buyer address (default: market wallet) |
| `--provider-address` | text | — | no | Provider address |
| `--job-id` | text | — | no | Job id (default: probe_<random>) |
| `--amount` | text | `0.01` | no | Payment amount in AIT (default: 0.01). |
| `--access-key` | text | — | no | payload.access_key (default: generated) |
| `--access-secret` | text | — | no | payload.access_secret (default: generated) |
| `--ttl-seconds` | integer | `7200` | no | Job ttl_seconds (default: 7200). |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market job-probe
aitbc market job-probe --output json
```
